name: rae-local-chat
description: Local AI chat UI over Ollama — React/Vite SPA + FastAPI + Postgres

scripts.migrate: docker compose exec api uv run alembic -c db/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.migration: docker compose exec api uv run alembic -c db/alembic.ini revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && pnpm -C frontend lint
scripts.typecheck: uv run mypy api/src db/src && pnpm -C frontend typecheck
scripts.test: uv run --package rae-api pytest api/tests && pnpm -C frontend test
